about.heading: About SUPER PAK DATA
about.intro: SUPER PAK DATA is a professional goods transportation and logistics company specializing in reliable freight services between Karachi and Lahore. We are committed to providing safe, efficient, and cost-effective cargo transportation solutions for businesses and individuals across Pakistan.
about.mission: To provide the most reliable, secure, and professional goods transportation service on the Karachi-to-Lahore route, ensuring every shipment is delivered safely and on time — every time.
about.vision: To be the most trusted name in goods transportation across Pakistan, known for integrity, professionalism, and exceptional service delivery.

ownerSection.heading: Leadership
ownerSection.ownerBio: Faisal Hussain Bhatti is the founder and owner of SUPER PAK DATA. With a deep understanding of Pakistan's freight and logistics industry, he established the company with a vision to provide reliable and professional goods transportation services, particularly on the Karachi–Lahore corridor.

about.servicesIntro: SUPER PAK DATA offers a comprehensive range of freight and cargo transportation services. From LCL (Less than Container Load) for smaller shipments to FCL (Full Container Load) for bulk cargo — we handle it all with professionalism and care.

services.heading: Comprehensive Cargo Transportation Services
services.subheading: Tailored freight solutions for every business need — from small parcels to full container loads.

services.title: LCL Transportation
services.subtitle: Less than Container Load
services.description: For customers who do not require a full container, our LCL service provides an economical and reliable option to transport smaller cargo shipments from Karachi to Lahore.

services.title: FCL Transportation
services.subtitle: Full Container Load
services.description: For customers requiring complete container capacity, our FCL service provides dedicated full-container transportation ensuring maximum security and efficiency for large volume cargo.

services.title: Karachi to Lahore Transportation
services.subtitle: Inter-City Freight Route
services.description: Our primary and most established route. We provide reliable, scheduled freight transportation between Karachi and Lahore, covering the entire distance with professional drivers and maintained vehicles.

services.title: Goods & Cargo Transportation
services.subtitle: Commercial Freight Services
services.description: We handle a wide range of commercial goods and cargo types. Our experienced team ensures proper loading, securing, and transportation of your goods to prevent any damage during transit.

services.title: Door-to-Door Transportation
services.subtitle: Pickup & Delivery Service
services.description: Our door-to-door service means we pick up your cargo directly from your location in Karachi and deliver it to your specified destination in Lahore — no need to transport goods to a depot.

services.title: Commercial Freight
services.subtitle: Business Cargo Solutions
services.description: Specialized commercial freight transportation designed for businesses that require regular, reliable shipments between Karachi and Lahore. We work with businesses of all sizes.

lcl.heading: Less than Container Load Transportation
lcl.subheading: The smart, economical choice for smaller cargo shipments from Karachi to Lahore.
lcl.intro: Our LCL (Less than Container Load) service is designed for businesses and individuals who need to transport cargo that doesn't fill an entire container. Instead of paying for unused container space, you only pay for the space your cargo actually occupies — making it an economical and practical choice for smaller shipments.

steps.title: Contact Us
steps.description: Reach out to us with your cargo details, size, weight and destination.

steps.title: Get a Quote
steps.description: We provide you with a competitive, transparent quote based on your cargo volume.

steps.title: Cargo Collection
steps.description: We collect your cargo from your location in Karachi and consolidate it securely.

steps.title: Transportation
steps.description: Your cargo is transported safely along with other shipments in our container fleet.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: Your cargo is delivered to your specified location in Lahore, safely and on time.

benefits.heading: Benefits of LCL
items: Pay only for the space your cargo uses
Suitable for all types of commercial goods
Cost-effective for small to medium businesses

cta.heading: Need LCL Transportation?
cta.subheading: Contact us for a free LCL cargo quote.

fcl.heading: Full Container Load Transportation
fcl.subheading: Complete container capacity for your large volume cargo shipments from Karachi to Lahore.
fcl.intro: Our FCL (Full Container Load) service provides dedicated container transportation for businesses with large volume cargo. When you book FCL, the entire container is reserved exclusively for your cargo — providing maximum security, privacy, and efficiency for your shipment.

steps.title: Inquiry & Quote
steps.description: Contact us with your cargo specifications and we'll provide a detailed FCL quote.

steps.title: Container Assignment
steps.description: A full container is allocated exclusively for your cargo shipment.

steps.title: Loading
steps.description: Your cargo is professionally loaded and secured in the dedicated container.

steps.title: Sealed Transportation
steps.description: The sealed container is transported directly from Karachi to Lahore.

steps.title: Delivery & Unloading
steps.description: Delivered to your destination in Lahore where your cargo is unloaded.

benefits.heading: Benefits of FCL
items: Cost-effective per unit for bulk shipments
